title: More ways to make images, and a saner Veo default
summary:
A busy day for media models and audio compatibility, with better model discovery, clearer usage, and a round of CLI and documentation fixes.

FLUX.3 Image and Seedream 5.0 Flash arrived with reference-based editing and 1K or 2K output. Veo now defaults to landscape video and generates audio only when requested. An OpenAI image seed change was reverted the same day: unseeded generations remain new images on each call, while identical unseeded edits can still use the cache.

Default speech requests and the tts-1 aliases now use OpenAI TTS, so they work with Quest Pollen. Audio routes gained consistent duration and upload parameter names; gpt-4o-transcribe works as a transcription alias; and chat audio data URLs no longer get double-encoded.

Gen and MCP can search and filter the catalog, while Open WebUI can filter /v1/models by category tags. The SDK gained a typed Jev decision call alongside the new Liquid D1 decision model and Ling 3.1 Flash; Qwen3 Coder 30B kept its aliases on a new Bedrock route. Community-model owners now use Private instead of a separate hide toggle, and catalog health signals no longer require repeated raw-event scans.
